normal: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: ONE standalone transparent 2D weapon sprite for Denti, a warm playful cartoon dental arena game. Input image 1 is the exact normal Kronenwerfer from the game's weapon atlas, the sole edit target. Create its normal unenchanted form on a portrait 1024 x 1536 pixel canvas with true transparent RGBA background. Preserve its existing recognizable design: a compact ivory-and-gold dental crown launcher with a single broad circular barrel aimed diagonally up-right, ONE clearly visible small gold royal crown loaded inside the open barrel, a white tooth on a round teal medallion on the body, a red trigger and TWO distinct grips beneath: the rear-left grip has a turquoise inset, the front-right grip is red with gold bands. Keep the teal top button and small teal rear cap; the crown remains INSIDE the muzzle, not floating above or beside the weapon. Keep the exact relative positioning and proportions of the barrel, crown, body, tooth medallion, trigger and both grips, and retain original 3/4 angle, painterly glossy cartoon shading and clean dark outlines. Do not redesign, mirror or rotate. Show the complete weapon centrally inside the portrait canvas, approximately x=0.08 to x=0.94 and y=0.27 to y=0.80, with rear grip near (0.30,0.68) and muzzle near (0.82,0.36). Leave transparent padding around every part, including at the right edge. No hands, no characters, no text, no extra crowns, no other weapons, no floating jewelry, no projectiles, no effects outside the weapon, no floor shadow, no broad background glow. Keep the identity of a simple crown launcher and its TWO grips. This normal sprite is the shared composition reference for six later elemental variants.
